caption: The drawing consists of three separate color illustrations arranged vertically on a plain, beige background. At the top, there is an oval-shaped image of a basket filled with various flowers and leaves, primarily in shades of pink and brown, with accents of green and dark brown against a light blue background. In the middle section, there is a rectangular scene featuring two white deer with pink outlines and spots, one standing and one lying down, amidst green trees and shrubs with brown trunks, on a brown and green grassy ground, set against a light blue sky. At the bottom, there is an image of an oval container, shown in perspective, with the floral basket design on its lid and the deer and tree scene wrapping around its curved side. The container and the other illustrated sections contain the same color palette: pink, brown, green, blue, and white.
title: Bandbox
